name: YEWLEE
recent: Yew Lee Pacific 近期多次因凭单转换为普通股而发布附加上市公告，同时董事 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭市期间申报了股份与凭单的权益变动及出售。公司也持续进行股份回购。
notable: 董事 Datuk Ang Lee Leong 在闭市期间出售 280,000 股普通股及 1,100,000 张凭单。
公司多次因凭单行使而发行新股，最近一次发行 82,300 股普通股。
公司于 2026 年 9 月至 10 月期间多次进行股份回购。
risks: 董事在闭市期间出售股份及凭单。
凭单持续转换为新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 MYR 4,805,000，环比增长1.3%，同比增长5.8%；净利为 MYR 527,000，环比下降62.7%，但较去年同期大幅增长。净利率为11.0%，低于上一季度的29.8%。

recent_en: Yew Lee Pacific recently made several additional listing announcements due to warrant conversions into ordinary shares, while Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong reported changes in his share and warrant interests and disposals during the closed period. The company also continued with share buybacks.
notable_en: Director Datuk Ang Lee Leong disposed of 280,000 ordinary shares and 1,100,000 warrants during the closed period.
The company issued new shares multiple times due to warrant exercises, with the latest issuance of 82,300 ordinary shares.
The company conducted several share buybacks between September and October 2026.
risks_en: The director disposed of shares and warrants during the closed period.
Ongoing warrant conversions into new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 4,805,000, up 1.3% QoQ and 5.8% YoY; net income was MYR 527,000, down 62.7% QoQ but significantly higher YoY. Net margin was 11.0%, lower than 29.8% in the previous quarter.
